item.title: Anyone in a group game can ask for a change
item.summary: Any player can ask Murph in the group chat to change a group game, and it goes through once more than half of the group says yes.
item.details: Before anyone joins, the starter's edits apply right away. After that, the same limits as one-on-one games apply: tasks stay fixed once Day 1 begins, the start date can move until someone checks in, and the prize, length and schedule can change for the days ahead.
